acip: DE NAS GZHAN DON DU CHOS KYI SKU LAS GZUGS KYI SKUR LDANG BAR BYA'O SNYAM PA'I 'PHEN PA BYAS LA, DE LTAR SNANG BA THAMS CAD STONG PA'I NGANG LAS
wylie: de nas gzhan don du chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur ldang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa byas la, de ltar snang ba thams cad stong pa'i ngang las
english: Then make a resolution that--for the sake of others--you will rise out of the Dharma Body into the Form Body.  And so first we bring to mind a state of emptiness where everything that normally appears to us is gone.
